He was a grandson of Emperor Alexander III through his mother but was not entitled to the title Grand Duke of Russia because he was only a great-grandson of Emperor Nicholas I in the male line. He lived in the south of France for the rest of his life after moving there to improve his health and stay closer to his son. He had a limited income and was too ill to work, relying on his ex-wife for support.
